reading.format: 16-course series delivered online; includes hands-on labs, projects, and a guided project to create a real-world generative AI application.
reading.summary: This is a 16-course professional certificate from IBM on Coursera. It teaches generative AI engineering, including large language models, natural language processing, prompt engineering, and building applications with Python libraries and frameworks such as Flask, PyTorch, RAG, and LangChain. Completing it shows ability to build and deploy generative AI applications, agents, and chatbots, and earns an employer-recognized certificate from IBM.
reading.audience: It is for aspiring generative AI engineers, AI developers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI research engineers. No prior experience is required.
